description: A large mute button for a stereo pair, fading the signal down rather than cutting it

params.text: Mutes both channels on one click and unmutes them on the next, fading over a few milliseconds either way; it reads MUTE in red while sound is passing and UNMUTE in green while muted

inputs.text: The left signal to be muted
The right signal to be muted

outputs.text: Carries the left input, faded to silence while muted
Carries the right input, faded to silence while muted
